comments.author: George
comments.body: ok it's confirmed you have to go to goa buy the jibs then go to the island of sumatra southwest coast. then goto the large boulder it the top left corner and a box will come up where you give them. then the quest is completed.

comments.author: Paulien
comments.body:
Just finished this today.. Not really clear hints from the Quest.
But confirmed on above steps. After speaking with Barkeep in Pondicherry, just head straight to the Diagonal Boulder in Southwest Sumatra landing point

Safe sail

comments.body: Eh? You only need flying inner jibs from Goa when you're doing the Calicut IQ "Shortening the survey period". This one right here just has you go places and talk-talk-talk-click-on-a-boulder, like the guide directions say. George's advice is right, but kinda in the wrong place...
